body: Hold recorded in private blocker #350. Source inspection of the actual PatchMon 2.1.3 image revision shows GetHomepage statistics credentials also pass enrollment authentication; requesting a zero daily cap becomes 100. This is source evidence, not a demonstrated runtime exploit. A reviewed upstream statistics-only credential contract and owned official headless issuance/reuse are required. #291 remains open; this PR remains draft, the descriptor remains unregistered, and native/rendered/lifecycle acceptance is not claimed. Tracker-only follow-up; no source or runtime changes.
